# Constructinator

> Combine up to six WhatsApp or LINE chat exports into one new AI persona and render it as a Soul Pack (replacement persona files for Irises and IrisesWeb). Bring your own OpenRouter key and pick any model. Inspired by Project Capricorn (Capri) from Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2.

- [README](https://github.com/rivianpratama/Constructinator/blob/main/README.md): what it does, quick start, models, privacy
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/rivianpratama/Constructinator/blob/main/AGENTS.md): commands, hard rules and code map for agents building this repo
- [PLAN.md](https://github.com/rivianpratama/Constructinator/blob/main/PLAN.md): full design and pipeline
